config.reference_status: Accepted by coordinator and independent numerical reviewer for bounded Gaussian-compact pilot; absorption coverage is empirical/conditional and distinct from ABC modeling error.
config.head_input_scaling: Coefficient PCA on the frozen learned-bank training outputs initializes the common affine head; standardized scores are dimensionless, so latent input scales are one. This does not replace the trained neural spatial bank with POD.
fit_starts: six equally spaced rows of the trained training-code table
config.fit_doubled_budget: 800 iterations from the exact same eight initial starts as the 400-iteration run; select the best finite result uniformly.
config.accuracy_rule: At primary dt all16 validation trajectories complete with time-maximum normalized displacement, velocity and energy-state errors <=.10; finest two steps agree within .01 on all three scales; selected fits stationary/rank-valid and 400/800 objective change<=1e-6. Final cohort sealed. This is a provisional engineering target.
config.pod_algorithm: Fresh randomized SVD, rank64+24 oversampling, four power iterations, normalized training displacement+velocity only.
